CREATE TABLE "public"."restriction_cases" (
  "closed_by_account_id" uuid,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "explanation_due_at" timestamptz,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "idempotency_key" character varying(200),
  "lifted_at" timestamptz,
  "measure" text,
  "measure_applied_at" timestamptz,
  "notice_sent_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "opened_by_account_id" uuid,
  "planned_measure" text,
  "reason_code" text NOT NULL,
  "reason_text" text NOT NULL,
  "source" text NOT NULL,
  "source_check_id" uuid,
  "source_report_id" uuid,
  "state" text NOT NULL,
  "subject_academy_id" uuid,
  "subject_kind" text NOT NULL,
  "subject_member_id" uuid,
  "subject_staff_account_id" uuid,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "urgent" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_restriction_idempotency_key_7d8ee603" CHECK (idempotency_key IS NULL OR char_length(idempotency_key) > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_restriction_reason_f13e51b3" CHECK (char_length(btrim(reason_text)) > 0 AND char_length(reason_code) > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_restriction_state_measure_6c177359" CHECK (state <> 'measure_applied' OR (measure IS NOT NULL AND measure_applied_at IS NOT NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_restriction_subject_e4eb745d" CHECK ((subject_kind = 'member' AND subject_member_id IS NOT NULL AND subject_staff_account_id IS NULL AND subject_academy_id IS NULL) OR (subject_kind = 'instructor' AND subject_staff_account_id IS NOT NULL AND subject_member_id IS NULL AND subject_academy_id IS NULL) OR (subject_kind = 'academy' AND subject_academy_id IS NOT NULL AND subject_member_id IS NULL AND subject_staff_account_id IS NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "restriction_cases_measure_check_ac9702ab" CHECK ("measure" IN ('warning', 'feature_limit', 'listing_limit', 'payout_hold', 'suspension', 'termination')),
  CONSTRAINT "restriction_cases_planned_measure_check_2a08ace2" CHECK ("planned_measure" IN ('warning', 'feature_limit', 'listing_limit', 'payout_hold', 'suspension', 'termination')),
  CONSTRAINT "restriction_cases_source_check_a0510dfe" CHECK ("source" IN ('report', 'business_status', 'operator_manual')),
  CONSTRAINT "restriction_cases_state_check_751d67ac" CHECK ("state" IN ('notice_sent', 'explained', 'measure_applied', 'lifted', 'dismissed')),
  CONSTRAINT "restriction_cases_subject_kind_check_5f9f070b" CHECK ("subject_kind" IN ('member', 'instructor', 'academy'))
)
